pnpm.comment: Overrides for transitive dependencies carrying HIGH/CRITICAL advisories that their direct parents have not yet released a fix for. Each entry is a floor, not a pin, so a parent that later bumps past it still wins. Re-check with `pnpm audit --prod --audit-level=high` and drop entries once the parent ships the fix. NOTE undici: the floor is BOUNDED to <7 deliberately. An unbounded '>=6.27.0' resolved to undici 8, whose handler interface (onRequestStart) is incompatible with @qdrant/js-client-rest, which declares ^6.23.0 — every Qdrant call then failed with 'fetch failed / invalid onRequestStart method' while plain global fetch still worked, so it looked like a network fault. Keep majors bounded.
